profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary: My name is Eric and I have a degree in Software Development. I have experience coding and designing videogames which can be viewed on my GitHub page. I recently finished a fully-functional multiplayer FPS game and am currently working on creating minigames for Facebook as a side-gig.  With a passion for both videogames and coding, I am motivated to become a creator of new innovative virtual game experiences. With my fluency in both Mandarin Chinese and English, I am interested in progressing internationally with my career.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Design and modify Websites
- Create appealing UI and cross-browser compatibility
-Expertise and hands on experience with C#, ASP.NET, MVC, HTML, CSS, Javascript, JQuery, and API's.
-Used wordpress to create multiple websites for events and conventions. 
-Edited lambda functions in AWS to grab customer info and pass it to drip to fire off emails.
-Utilized postman to run scripts that talked to different api's.
- Developed a website for a new client Solely Jane, setting them up on nopcommerce and integrated them with Exigo.
-Migrated data from existing Chalkcouture database to new Nopcommerce database
-Created multiple plugins and widgets in nopcommerce
-Headed the project of a complete redesign for the front facing website, including upgrading Bootstrap and making website more mobile responsive.
-Helped create a mobile app using react expo
-Implemented load testing procedures by uploading jmeter tests to redline 13 which simulated chalk coutures traffic spikes and helped solve multiple pain points and slow calls through stackify, then coded the solution to fix the slow areas.
positions.insights: Skills: Back-End Web Development · Web Development · HTML · NetSuite · Front-End Development
